title: feat(service-messaging): a keyed notification param can be a list, read in the recipient's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQVQdf3PvoJbKFFCUA4gwJB)_

Fixes #36853

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/service-messaging`, `notification-text.ts`.** `EmitInput.keyedText.params` accepts a list-shaped value, `{ list, separator }` (`NotificationListParam`).
  - Each `list` item is `{ key, params?, fallback }`: a catalog sentence with its own `{{hole}}` params, which are scalar only (`NotificationScalarParam`: text, `{ key, fallback }` or `{ object, fallback }`).
  - The renderer fills each item per recipient through the same scalar resolution a top-level hole uses. An item with no entry falls back to its `fallback`.
  - The items are joined by the `separator` entry, else its `fallback`. `lookupSeparator` keeps a whitespace or punctuation answer such as `、`, which `lookup` would treat as a blank sentence.
  - `problemOf` is split into `scalarParamProblem`, `keyedParamProblem` and `listParamProblem`. `emit()` refuses an empty list, a list over `NOTIFICATION_LIST_PARAM_MAX_ITEMS` (100), an undeclared member, a malformed separator or item, and a list nested in an item. A stored malformed row reads back as `undefined` and is delivered as its literal, as any malformed row is.
  - New exports: `NotificationListParam`, `NotificationListItem`, `NotificationScalarParam` and `NOTIFICATION_LIST_PARAM_MAX_ITEMS`. Every existing param shape renders byte for byte as before.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-approvals`.**
  - `noApproverNotice` spells a slate of two or more slots as `approvalNoApproverHolding` with `who` the list param: one `approvalNoApproverSlot` per slot with its `type` / `value` params, joined by `approvalNoApproverSlotSeparator`. Each item falls back to the English clause the row stores.
  - `approval-notification-text.ts` mirrors the new shapes structurally (`ApprovalListParam`, `ApprovalScalarParam`), because the plugin keeps no runtime dependency on the messaging package. `interpolate` renders a list's literal from its items' fallbacks.
  - A one-slot slate keeps `approvalNoApproverHoldingSlot`.
- Tests and a changeset (both packages `patch`).

## Why

A `{ key }` param resolves through `t(key, locale)` with no params, so a hole held one text or one hole-free key. #36463 (PR #36846) spelled slates of 2 to 8 slots with one derived sentence per size. A slate of more than 8 slots still named its slots in English inside a zh-CN, ja-JP or other non-English submitter's sentence.

## Verification

- `admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts` adds a 9-slot slate opened by the real service. It is rendered through the real `NotificationTextRenderer` in zh-CN, and the body is entirely Chinese, with `not.toMatch(/[A-Za-z]/)`. The `en` render equals the literal the row stores. This is the card's acceptance test.
- `notification-text-list-param-36853.test.ts` drives the real renderer over the kernel's in-memory `i18n`, with 9 tests:
  - nine items in zh-CN, joined by `、`, and the same list in `en`
  - per-item and separator fallback
  - an object-label param and a plain-text param inside an item
  - every refusal `emit()` makes, and a stored row read back
- `no-approver-note.test.ts`:
  - the two-slot notice shape is now the list
  - "every slate size reads the timeline's sentence in every pack" now runs from 2 to 12 slots, past the 8 #36463 spelled
  - the old "more than 8 keeps English" pin is replaced by "nine slots name no English approver type in any pack but `en`"
- `vitest run`: `service-messaging` 82 files, 1107 passed; `plugin-approvals` 130 files, 1965 passed.
- `pnpm typecheck` passes in both packages. `plugin-approvals` `check:test-typecheck` is OK, with no change to its ledger.
- `eslint` is clean on every changed file. `check-test-source-alias` is OK, and `overlap-check` is clean against `origin/main`.

## Small decisions

- The `approvalNoApproverHoldingSlots2` to `…Slots8` sentences are **not** retired. Notices already delivered carry those keys in their stored `keyedText`, and the inbox renders them again at every read (`renderForReader`). Retiring them would turn those rows back into English. New notices no longer emit them.
- A list item's params are scalar only, never another list. One level covers the card. A nested list would need a second separator and a depth bound for no current producer.
- An item or separator that misses falls back alone, the way every other keyed param falls back. The rest of the list stays in the reader's language.
- The list is capped at 100 items, because it is rendered item by item at every delivery and every inbox read. An approval slate is a handful of slots.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The widening is the published `keyedText.params` value shape of `@objectstack/service-messaging`: a new accepted shape, with every existing shape unchanged. No metadata author writes it.

## Owed

- L1 (seat). Clause-② widening of a service package's exported emit contract, so the seat rules whether a contract review is owed.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
